Which one of the following is an example of an Irrelevant! flaw?

Correct! You got it right on the first try!
A

Dolphins engage in social rituals akin to those seen in early human populations. Indeed, such social rituals may approach what can be described as theistic practices. Therefore, we can conclude that dolphins are omnivores.

Irrelevant! flaws are what they sound like. The premises have nothing to do with the conclusion. Irrelevant! flaws are fairly rare, so don't assume every flawed argument you encounter is Irrelevant!

B

Dolphins are quite chatty, frequently vocalizing their needs to one another. Therefore, we can conclude that dolphins have vocal cords.

C

Dolphins are adept communicators, and much of dolphin culture is based on shared interactions. So we can safely assume that dolphin survival is predicated upon social connections.

Question 5

Which one of the following is an example of Percentages ≠ Numbers?

Correct!

Percentages and numbers are not the same. Just because a raw number went up, that doesn't mean there was an increase in percentage. If the percentage changed, that doesn't mean the raw number changed.
